rubrics.justification: Generally recognizes an advanced blastocyst and appropriately notes limits of a single still image, but it overcalls hatching/thinned zona and strong ICM/TE visibility from the image, which are not clearly demonstrable here.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, endometrium, diagnosis, semen parameters, prior cycle history, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with conclusions mostly supported by the case data; minor issue is leaning heavily on reported morphology despite image ambiguity.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with Gardner grading interpretation, single embryo transfer in a good-prognosis patient, and standard IVF practice; minor overprecision in outcome estimates prevents a perfect score.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer, luteal support considerations, lifestyle guidance, and sensible future-cycle planning including when to investigate maturity rate or consider PGT-A.
